'''Alzar Golan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who flew [[corusca skiff]]s in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]].

==Biography==
Alzar Golan was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]],<ref name="GG2-1" /> who joined the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and was commissioned as an [[Ensign/Legends|ensign]],<ref name="GG2-2">[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin'', Second Edition]]</ref> flying [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]].<ref name="GG2-1" /> Initially, Golan performed well, especially under officers he respected. However, he soon came under the command of officers that were substandard. Golan openly mocked his superior officers' command styles and questioned their orders.<ref name="GG2-2" /> He believed that they weren't his "superior" in any sense of the word,<ref name="GG2-1" /> and failed to do the smart thing and humor them until they were transferred out.<ref name="GG2-2" /> Eventually, he was cashiered out of the service for insubordination to his superiors.<ref name="GG2-1" />

Moving from port to port, Golan took jobs in the private sector. However, his daredevil piloting continually got him fired as he risked company-owned [[Starship/Legends|starships]] in high traffic areas and bad weather, and performed outrageous stunts. Eventually, Golan found himself in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]], and was employed to fly the [[corusca skiff]]s collecting valuable [[Corusca gem/Legends|Corusca Stone]]s.<ref name="GG2-2" />

==Personality and traits==
At 1.67 [[Meter/Legends|meters]], Alzar Golan was of medium height, with close-cropped [[Color/Legends|black]] hair and dark eyes. He was possessed of a lantern jaw, and had a prominent lump that protruded from his throat.<ref name="GG2-1" /> Golan was extremely confident, often to the point of being reckless. If given the chance, he would have happily tried to buff [[Palpatine/Legends|the Emperor]] during a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game.<ref name="GG2-1" /> A daredevil and a show off, Golan was a capable pilot and held the opinion that he could fly anything with an engine. His time with the Empire highlighted his fatal flaw; Golan had a big mouth and no tact. Despite his outgoing personality, he favored subdued and conservative clothing.<ref name="GG2-2" />

==Skills and abilities==
Golan was trained to use a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]],<ref name="GG2-2" /> as well as [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapons]], and could [[Unarmed combat/Legends|handle himself]] in a fight. A capable [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], he could [[Astrogation/Legends|plot]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] courses and operate the weapons on a starship. Golan could also operate [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles, and was knowledgeable about [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]. He was also competent in survival techniques, and was connected to the criminal underworld.<ref name="GG2-1" />

==Equipment==
Golan was armed with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], as well as a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]], and wore a [[high-g suit]].<ref name="GG2-1" />
